test_tokenize: test the SimpleFeaturizer to tokenize raw text into lowercase tokens and character lists
test_tokenize_dont_lowercase: test the SimpleFeaturizer with lowercase_tokens False to preserve original token casing
test_convert_to_bytes: test the SimpleFeaturizer with convert_to_bytes True to split text into individual character tokens
test_tokenize_add_sentence_markers: test the SimpleFeaturizer with sentence_markers to prepend and append start end tokens
test_split_with_regex: test the SimpleFeaturizer with a custom split_regex to tokenize text using regex delimiters
